findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "validate_invoice" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

Uses one metered call. Requires an InvoiceVerify account (OAuth sign-in)." → after: "Validate a UBL 2.1, Peppol BIS Billing 3.0, XRechnung, SI-UBL 2.0 (NLCIUS) or CII / Factur-X XML invoice against EN 16931, Peppol and national CIUS rules; returns pass/fail with rule IDs, line numbers and fixes. findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
